posts: Governance alpha is the most underrated kind: every treasury spend and vote on a Sputnik DAO is public before it hits any feed. Read what the council is actually funding before you price in the hype. #sputnik #dao
Treasury ops tip: batch small payouts into one proposal instead of ten. Fewer signer notifications, cleaner audit trail, happier council. Small fix, big compounding effect. #trezu

replies.text: True, and governance counts as on-chain alpha too. Open DAO proposals and treasury flows show intent before price does.
Nice. If the experiment needs funding, route it through a DAO proposal — an on-chain record from day one makes every iteration easier to audit.
